invariant_requirements: No original source Unicode edits, no omitted brackets/harakat, no retranslation to improve tests.
Do not rebuild old unchanged 120/120 apparatus matrix or reupload retired complete PDFs.
Do not assume green browser Blob run implies Unicode/PDF/A/UA/source geometry quality.
Never merge isolated Stage 2 research branches into production without all reader/layout/device/license gates.
Every future experiment records source/font/fixture SHA, hypothesis, test script, browser/native PDF engine, run ID, output PDF SHA.
Read current branch heads and latest CI before editing; do not overwrite parallel chats' work.
Only repeat an experiment if a materially changed input/hypothesis/final integration SHA or missing artifact requires it.
